question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Encumbrance
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hurdle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Encumbrance"** refers to a burden or impediment that hinders or obstructs progress. (बाधा या रुकावट)

 
 
• **Example:** The encumbrance of heavy luggage made their journey extremely difficult.
 
 
 
• **"Hurdle"** means an obstacle or difficulty that must be overcome. (बाधा)
 
 
• **Example:** She faced many hurdles while starting her own business but managed to succeed.
 
 
 
• Both "Encumbrance" and "Hurdle" refer to obstacles, making "Hurdle" the most appropriate synonym for "Encumbrance."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hurdle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Incentive** (प्रोत्साहन): A reward or encouragement to motivate someone to act.

 
 
• **Example:** The company offered incentives to employees for achieving their targets.
 
 
 
• **Catalyst** (उत्प्रेरक): Something or someone that causes or accelerates change or action.
 
 
• **Example:** Her speech acted as a catalyst for social reform in the community.
 
 
 
• **Impetus** (प्रेरणा): A force or influence that makes something happen or happen faster.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policies gave an impetus to economic growth.
